########################################################################
# Python QA registration (M0 review R8 / P2).
#
# test_twr_config.py is the QA for the pure-Python TWR configuration layer:
# DEFAULT DENY, the effective-config snapshot, JSON round trip and the
# cross-check against the C++ header and the measured whitelist CSV.  It was
# never registered with CTest, so a green `ctest` said nothing about the
# Python half of REQ-API-01 -- and it was reachable only by hand, from a source
# checkout.
#
# The module deliberately resolves its own paths from __file__ (source
# gr-uwb/python, the C++ header, the measured CSV), so it needs no PYTHONPATH
# and no built extension: that is the point of the pure-Python design.  What
# it DOES need is a deterministic environment, because the generated CTest
# shell scripts elsewhere in this project inherit the caller's
# LD_LIBRARY_PATH / PYTHONPATH and can therefore resolve a stale
# /usr/local/libgnuradio-uwb or an installed `uwb` package instead of the
# checkout under test.  The ENVIRONMENT below pins both, so `ctest` and a
# hand-run resolve identically.
########################################################################
if(PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    add_test(NAME uwb_qa_twr_config_py
        COMMAND ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test_twr_config.py
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

    # The test asserts `gnuradio` is NOT importable, so it must not be handed
    # a build tree whose pybind module would satisfy that import.  Pin an empty
    # PYTHONPATH rather than inheriting one.
    set_property(TEST uwb_qa_twr_config_py APPEND PROPERTY
        ENVIRONMENT
            "PYTHONPATH="
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1"
            "GR_DONT_LOAD_PREFS=1"
            "GR_CONF_CONTROLPORT_ON=False"
            "UWB_TWR_PYTHON_QA=ctest")
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_twr_config_py PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 300
        # A hand-edited checkout or a stale installed uwb package must not make
        # this test's result depend on run order, so it never runs alongside
        # anything else.
        RUN_SERIAL TRUE)

    message(STATUS "UWB CTest: registered uwb_qa_twr_config_py "
                   "(apps/test_twr_config.py)")
endif()

########################################################################
# M1-B: the offline two-endpoint simulation demo and its independent checks.
#
# `twr_fake_demo` links ONLY the standalone `uwb_twr_core` archive and the
# QA-only fake link -- never gnuradio-uwb and never UHD -- so running it is
# itself evidence that the protocol core is radio-free (M1-B §8).
#
# The Python demo/QA and the independent verifier are registered here so a
# green `ctest` covers B17 rather than only a hand run.  The demo never
# bypasses a capability gate: it runs with an explicit simulation envelope.
########################################################################
add_executable(twr_fake_demo twr_fake_demo.cc)
target_include_directories(twr_fake_demo PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
target_link_libraries(twr_fake_demo PRIVATE uwb_twr_core uwb_twr_fake_link)

if(PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    add_test(NAME uwb_qa_twr_fake_demo_py
        COMMAND ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test_twr_fake_demo.py
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    set_property(TEST uwb_qa_twr_fake_demo_py APPEND PROPERTY
        ENVIRONMENT
            "PYTHONPATH="
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1"
            "UWB_TWR_FAKE_DEMO=$<TARGET_FILE:twr_fake_demo>")
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_twr_fake_demo_py PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 300 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)

    # The independent verifier re-derives the ToF from the frame fields and the
    # transport model without calling the C++ at all.  It needs a real
    # request/output pair, generated in a scratch dir on the fly.
    add_test(NAME uwb_qa_twr_m1b_verify_py
        COMMAND sh -c
            "d=$(mktemp -d ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/m1b_verify.XXXXXX) && \
${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/twr_fake_demo.py --scenario ds_unity \
    --request-out $d/req.json --output $d/out.json && \
${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tools/twr/verify_m1_b_protocol.py \
    --request $d/req.json --output $d/out.json; rc=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $rc")
    set_property(TEST uwb_qa_twr_m1b_verify_py APPEND PROPERTY
        ENVIRONMENT
            "PYTHONPATH="
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1"
            "UWB_TWR_FAKE_DEMO=$<TARGET_FILE:twr_fake_demo>")
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_twr_m1b_verify_py PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 300 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)

    message(STATUS "UWB CTest: registered uwb_qa_twr_fake_demo_py + "
                   "uwb_qa_twr_m1b_verify_py (M1-B demo + verifier)")
endif()

########################################################################
# Installed-Consumer release gate (M0 review R8 / P2, review defect N05).
#
# install_consumer/ proves the INSTALLED public API is usable and DEFAULT
# DENY: it compiles install_consumer.cc and runs install_consumer.py against
# an install prefix and NOTHING else, exercising `uwb_twr_tof_input.h`'s
# `admit_range_capable_time()` / `admit_ranging_interval()` rather than merely
# including the header.  It was never registered with CTest, so a green
# `ctest` said nothing about the installed deliverable -- the reviewer found
# the two consumers stale (`twr-config/1`) and the admission header missing
# from the prefix.
#
# The prefix is supplied at configure time (after an install) because an
# ordinary developer build has no installed prefix to test.  When
# UWB_TWR_INSTALL_PREFIX is empty, or the prefix has no installed headers, the
# wrapper prints why and exits 77; SKIP_RETURN_CODE turns that into a SKIPPED
# CTest case rather than a failure, so the normal build is never broken by the
# absence of an install.  To make it part of the release gate:
#
#   cmake -S gr-uwb -B build -DUWB_TWR_INSTALL_PREFIX=<prefix>
#   ctest --test-dir build -R uwb_qa_install_consumer
#
# GR_PYTHON_DIR is the configured Python install directory (dist-packages on a
# stock local install), passed so the wrapper does not have to guess
# site-packages.
########################################################################
set(UWB_TWR_INSTALL_PREFIX "" CACHE PATH
    "Prefix of an installed gr-uwb used by the install_consumer release gate; \
empty means the case is SKIPPED")
if(PYTHONINTERP_FOUND AND UNIX)
    add_test(NAME uwb_qa_install_consumer
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/install_consumer/run_install_consumer.sh
                --prefix "${UWB_TWR_INSTALL_PREFIX}"
                --python-rel "${GR_PYTHON_DIR}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/install_consumer)
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_install_consumer PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 300
        # 77 == "no installed prefix available".  CTest reports SKIPPED
        # instead of FAILED, so the plain developer build stays green.
        SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77
        # The consumer compiles and imports against an install prefix that may
        # live outside the build tree; keep it alone for the same
        # stale-LD_LIBRARY_PATH / stale-install reasons as the Python QA.
        RUN_SERIAL TRUE)

    message(STATUS "UWB CTest: registered uwb_qa_install_consumer "
                   "(prefix='${UWB_TWR_INSTALL_PREFIX}'; empty => SKIP)")
endif()

########################################################################
# M2-A: offline native-rate PHY demo + independent verifier (G0 §10).
#
# `twr_native_phy_demo` links ONLY the static `uwb_twr_phy` archive (+ its
# PUBLIC Volk/Threads) -- never gnuradio-uwb / UHD -- so a green run is itself
# evidence that the closed loop is radio-free.
########################################################################
add_executable(twr_native_phy_demo twr_native_phy_demo.cc)
target_include_directories(twr_native_phy_demo PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
target_link_libraries(twr_native_phy_demo PRIVATE
    uwb_twr_phy Volk::volk Threads::Threads)
target_compile_definitions(twr_native_phy_demo PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\"")

# The verifier re-derives the frame bytes / CRC / lengths / decode verdict from
# the manifest WITHOUT calling the C++, so it needs no build tree.  It runs the
# demo on the fly to get a real manifest and then checks it, plus --self-test.
add_test(NAME uwb_qa_twr_m2a_native_phy_verify_py
    COMMAND sh -c
        "d=$(mktemp -d ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/m2a_verify.XXXXXX) && \
$<TARGET_FILE:twr_native_phy_demo> --frame poll --native-rate 737280000 --iq cf32 \
    --output $d/out.json && \
${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tools/twr/verify_m2_a_native_phy.py \
    --output $d/out.json --self-test; rc=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $rc")
set_property(TEST uwb_qa_twr_m2a_native_phy_verify_py APPEND PROPERTY
    ENVIRONMENT
        "PYTHONPATH="
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1")
set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_twr_m2a_native_phy_verify_py PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 300 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
